scope: Separate ARMv6-M arithmetic runtime; no libgcc.a members in the owned firmware. Physical qualification runs local SRAM APPs without flashing.

implementation.portable: Independent integer binary32/binary64 nearest-even kernels with gradual underflow, conversions, integer multiply/divide, CLZ and shifts.
implementation.rp2040: Normal binary64 kernels adapted from BSD-3-Clause Pico SDK 2.2.0; project IEEE fallback guards, chunked cancellation normalization, exact power-of-two multiplication/division and rational reciprocal seeds.
implementation.qfplib: External, separately linked comparison APP only; no GPL-2.0 Qfplib source or tables are included in the product.

build_comparison.note: Manifest source hashes include a compiler-runtime configuration marker; both builds use the same frozen source tree.

owned.board: ClockworkPi PicoCalc + Raspberry Pi Pico H

gcc_control.board: ClockworkPi PicoCalc + Raspberry Pi Pico H

build_comparison.archive_gate: Owned map has no libgcc.a members; GCC control is rejected by the same gate.

host_arithmetic.oracle: Host IEEE binary32/binary64, integer arithmetic and sqrt; no target runtime used as the oracle.

generic.abi: Cortex-M0, soft EABI registers, R4-R11/SP preserved; writes stack only
generic.timing_note: Instruction counts are emulator diagnostics, not measured RP2040 cycles.

rp2040.abi: Cortex-M0, soft EABI registers, R4-R11/SP preserved; writes stack and SIO divider only
rp2040.timing_note: Instruction counts are emulator diagnostics, not measured RP2040 cycles.

production_elf_math.abi: Cortex-M0, soft EABI registers, R4-R11/SP preserved; writes stack and SIO divider only
production_elf_math.timing_note: Instruction counts are emulator diagnostics, not measured RP2040 cycles.

benchmark.method: RP2040 TIMERAWL, 125 MHz, median of nine paired 1024-call batches minus identity; interrupts enabled.
benchmark.local_code_location: OWN and QFP execute in SRAM; GCC control is the resident Flash runtime.
benchmark.inputs: Twelve fixed normal pairs per operation, including close cancellation and powers of two. This is not a general speed claim over arbitrary input distributions.

local_math.location: Local compact_math and owned arithmetic execute in SRAM; no resident math imports.

physical_math.method: RP2040 TIMERAWL, 125 MHz, median of nine paired 1024-call batches minus identity; interrupts enabled.

build.code_location: All local implementations execute in SRAM; GCC control uses resident Flash.

limits: Full replacement firmware was built and its math executed from its ELF, but it was not flashed in this task.
Performance comparison is binary64 only; no claim is made that binary32 kernels outperform Qfplib.
Addition remains slower than Qfplib on this corpus; subtraction, multiplication and division have lower mean latency.
ROM bit operations and C memory intrinsics are modeled in production ELF emulation; bare ARMv6-M tests and physical local APPs execute actual arithmetic code.
